text: Which boutique law firms in Brisbane offer free initial consultations, fixed-fee wills, or deferred-fee options for family law and wills and estates?

sections.text:
Several Brisbane boutique or specialist firms advertise one or more of these cost arrangements:

| Firm | Relevant option | Area |
|---|---|---|
| **Bespoke Legal Group** | Free 20-minute initial consultation for family-law matters; fixed-fee estate-planning documents, including a standard will listed at $600 + GST and a will plus enduring power of attorney at $700 + GST.[3] | Family law; wills and estates |
| **Direct Lawyers** | Free 10-minute discovery call and fixed-fee will and estate-planning packages. The firm is based in West End and focuses on succession law.[1][4][8] | Wills and estates |
| **Genuine Legal** | Free, no-obligation family-law consultation; fixed-fee quotes and payment plans, including the possibility of commencing without an initial deposit where affordability is an issue.[7] | Family law |
| **Life Law Solutions** | Free initial consultation followed by fixed-fee estate-planning packages; Brisbane office in Mount Gravatt East.[6] | Wills and estates |
| **Melrose Keys Lawyers** | Free 10-minute introductory call; the firm is described as boutique and handles family law, wills and estates, and property law. A longer consultation is charged separately.[10] | Family law; wills and estates |
| **The Estate Lawyers** | Advertised free initial consultation and a deferred-fee option for eligible estate matters, allowing payment when inheritance funds are received.[2][10] | Wills and estates |
| **Nurture Law** | Complimentary initial chat is advertised in one Brisbane comparison listing, with fixed-fee estate services; another listing says a $295 initial fee may apply and be deducted from the package, so confirm the current arrangement.[2][10] | Wills and estates |
| **Dare Lawyers** | Boutique firm specialising in family law and wills and estates; its listing describes reasonable rates, but does not clearly confirm a free consultation, fixed-fee schedule, or deferred-fee arrangement.[5] | Family law; wills and estates |

**Best matches by need:**

- **Free family-law consultation:** Bespoke Legal Group or Genuine Legal.[3][7]
- **Fixed-fee wills:** Direct Lawyers, Bespoke Legal Group, Life Law Solutions, or Nurture Law.[1][3][6][10]
- **Deferred or delayed payment for an estate matter:** The Estate Lawyers appears the clearest match, subject to eligibility and the matter type.[2]
- **One firm covering both family law and wills/estates:** Bespoke Legal Group, Melrose Keys Lawyers, or Dare Lawyers.[3][5][10]

Before booking, confirm whether “free consultation” means a short screening call or a substantive legal appointment, whether GST is included, and whether deferred fees are available for your specific matter.
